shared_elements: arched/rounded lunette at top containing small figural scene
standing human figures in the lunette
many closely spaced horizontal lines of inscription filling the main field
flanking rock/pilaster masses at left and right of the panel
eroded, broken lower zone of the inscribed field
justification: Both show the identical scheme: a tall recessed panel framed by rock pilasters, with an arched lunette at top holding small standing figures flanking a central motif, and beneath it a dense block of ruled horizontal inscription lines that break away in the damaged lower half. The correspondence extends to the same proportions, the same broken irregular lower edge and the same flanking rock masses, so these are to all appearances the same monument seen from different viewpoints; only the vantage (frontal versus steeply from below) differs.
